text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Unprecedented participation, including 72 states, 850 companies and 2,000 investors, at the economic conference in Cairo. Egypt will present 99 industrial projects and 89 agricultural and service projects.

- Interior Minister Hassan el-Alfi says "We will resist any attempt to destabilise security during the economic conference." El-Alfi told Al-Ahram that the Sudanese regime was still providing shelter to terrorist elements.
- Presidential adviser Osama el-Baz: we expect the U.S. role in the peace process be activated. Re-negotiation will lead to deterioration of regional situations.
- Major national projects will be offered to investors. Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri says Egypt becomes qualified to enter the 21st century with giant national projects.
- Mobile phones will be offered for rent to participants of the Cairo economic conference.
- President Hosni Mubarak will deliver a speech at a joint session of the People's Assembly (parliament) and the Shura (consultative) Council on Sunday.
